description:
### 1. Overall Layout
The figure follows a clean, top-to-bottom block diagram structure with an aspect ratio of approximately 16:9, embodying a modern, minimalist academic aesthetic. The layout is divided into three distinct horizontal lanes representing the pipeline phases: **Top Lane** (Input), **Middle Lane** (Compression Pipeline), and **Bottom Lane** (Reader and Output). The design is highly organized, compact, and symmetrical, utilizing generous and intentional whitespace to separate the logical phases. A concisely formatted legend is neatly positioned in the lower-right corner.

### 2. Components
*   **Top Lane (Input):**
    *   A single wide, rounded rectangular box centered at the top, featuring a crisp white fill and a thin dark border.
    *   Inside the box is the text: "10 HotpotQA paragraphs (2 gold + 8 distractors) + question".
    *   Directly beneath this box is a visual icon row consisting of 10 small, flat circular dots arranged horizontally. Two of the dots are solid dark grey, and eight are light pale grey.
*   **Middle Lane (Compression Pipeline):**
    *   A perfectly aligned two-by-three grid of uniform rounded rectangular boxes representing six parallel processing methods.
    *   *Top Row (left to right):* Box 1 labeled "Truncate-first-N"; Box 2 labeled "Random paragraphs"; Box 3 labeled "Extractive top-k".
    *   *Bottom Row (left to right):* Box 4 labeled "Abstractive summary"; Box 5 labeled "Structured memory (JSON)"; Box 6 labeled "Iterative compaction (two rounds)".
    *   Centered below this grid is a single, moderately wide rounded box labeled "compressed context (~30% tokens)".
*   **Bottom Lane (Reader and Output):**
    *   A wide rounded box centered below the compressed context, labeled "Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct reader (frozen)".
    *   To the right of the reader box, a simple text element labeled "answer span" with no bounding box.
    *   Adjacent to "answer span" is a small, distinct pill-shaped badge labeled "F1 / EM".
    *   Positioned in this lane, clearly separated from the main flow for reference, is a rounded box labeled "full-context upper bound".
*   **Legend (Lower-Right Corner):**
    *   A small, cleanly bordered area mapping the categorical pastel colors and dot icons to their meanings, ensuring all visual metaphors are explicitly defined.

### 3. Connections
*   Orthogonal, slim dark grey lines with small, uniformly filled arrowheads dictate the data flow.
*   A primary arrow flows downward from the Top Lane input box, branching out cleanly at right angles to connect to the top center of all six boxes in the Middle Lane grid.
*   From the bottom center of each of the six compression boxes, individual solid arrows point downward, converging elegantly into the top of the single "compressed context (~30% tokens)" box.
*   A solid arrow flows straight down from the "compressed context" box into the top of the "Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct reader (frozen)" box.
*   A solid arrow points horizontally to the right from the "Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct reader (frozen)" box directly to the "answer span" text.

### 4. Groupings
*   The Middle Lane naturally groups the six compression methods, snapped to an implicit grid. The top-left and top-center boxes act as a visual sub-group for length-matched control baselines, while the remaining four boxes represent the learned compressors.
*   The input dots are grouped tightly together directly under the main input box to visually reinforce the ratio of gold to distractor paragraphs.

### 5. Labels and Annotations
All text must be rendered letter-perfect, with no abbreviations, paraphrasing, or title-casing adjustments.
*   **Input Box:** "10 HotpotQA paragraphs (2 gold + 8 distractors) + question"
*   **Grid Boxes:** "Truncate-first-N", "Random paragraphs", "Extractive top-k", "Abstractive summary", "Structured memory (JSON)", "Iterative compaction (two rounds)"
*   **Intermediate Output:** "compressed context (~30% tokens)"
*   **Reader Box:** "Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct reader (frozen)"
*   **Final Outputs:** "answer span", "F1 / EM"
*   **Reference Box:** "full-context upper bound"

### 6. Input/Output Flow
*   **System Input:** The raw HotpotQA paragraphs and question enter at the very top.
*   **System Output:** The pipeline concludes at the bottom right with the extracted "answer span", which is evaluated by the "F1 / EM" metrics.

### 7. Styling & Aesthetics
*   **Background & General Style:** Pure white background. Minimalist, modern academic style with no gradients, no 3D effects, no drop shadows, and no decorative background patterns.
*   **Lines & Borders:** All boxes are softened geometries (rounded rectangles) featuring thin, crisp, and consistent dark outlines (near-black). Arrows are slim and single-line with small, proportionate filled arrowheads.
*   **Typography:** All labels use a highly legible, neutral sans-serif font (such as Helvetica, Inter, or Roboto) at a clear, readable size. Text is solid dark grey or black to ensure maximum contrast.
*   **Color Palette (Categorical & Pastel):**
    *   *Soft Muted Blue:* Used as the fill for the control baselines ("Truncate-first-N", "Random paragraphs").
    *   *Pale Sage Green:* Used as the fill for "Extractive top-k".
    *   *Warm Peach:* Used as the fill for "Abstractive summary".
    *   *Soft Lavender:* Used as the fill for "Structured memory (JSON)".
    *   *Deep Rich Teal:* Used as the fill for "Iterative compaction (two rounds)" to provide a high-value contrast that makes this headline method stand out.
    *   *Pale Ice Blue:* Used as the fill for the "Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct reader (frozen)" box to visually denote its frozen, static state.
    *   *Soft Neutral Grey:* Used as the fill for the "full-context upper bound" reference box.
*   **Legend Styling:** Contains small colored squares corresponding to the box fills and tiny dot icons corresponding to the paragraph types, paired with clean sans-serif descriptive text matching the exact phrasing required by the source context.
